items: 1 Tbsp butter, melted and cooled (so as not to splatter)
3 cups flour, plus up to 1 more cup

steps.title: Dissolve the yeast
steps.body: Whisk and let sit 1 minute: **1½ cups warm water** and **2¼ tsp dry yeast**.

steps.title: Add seasonings
steps.body: Whisk in **1 tsp salt**, **1 Tbsp brown sugar** and **1 Tbsp butter, melted and cooled** (so as not to splatter).

steps.title: Add flour
steps.body: Gradually add **3 cups flour** and continue to add up to **1 more cup** until the dough is no longer sticky.

steps.title: Rest the dough
steps.body: Cover and let rest for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare the bath
steps.body: Preheat oven to 400°F and prepare baking soda bath: **9 cups boiling water** and **½ cup baking soda**.

steps.title: Cut and rope
steps.body: Cut dough into ⅓ cup sections and roll into 20-22 inch ropes.

steps.title: Shape and boil
steps.body: Shape into pretzels and boil for 20-30 seconds.

steps.title: Salt and bake
steps.body: Place on the baking sheet and sprinkle with coarse sea salt. Bake for 12-15 minutes or until golden brown.
